note: Brunei: ordinary passports of the countries listed enter without a visa for 90 days (the EU, the UK's citizens, North America, the EFTA states), 30 or 14 days (Passports (Visa) (Exemption) Order 1985 as amended); Australia and Kuwait take a visa on arrival for 30 days, and Bahrain, Qatar and Saudi Arabia one for 14. Everyone else needs a visa. Read on 2026-11-03 from the Ministry of Foreign Affairs' own country list (each country linked to its category) and each category's page, which give every country and length held; Wikipedia's copy had given Bahrain, Qatar and Saudi Arabia 30 days, which the Ministry's categories C2, C3 and C4 (14 days each) corrected.

sources.title: Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Brunei Darussalam: Visa Information, the countries by category (each linked to its category page)
sources.said: CATEGORY A Foreign nationals of countries in this category will require a visa to enter Brunei Darussalam, which can be applied through the nearest Brunei Darussalam's Missions Abroad. ... CATEGORY C Holders of all types passport from countries under this category could apply for Visa on Arrival upon entry into Brunei Darussalam. CATEGORY D Foreign nationals of countries under this category do not require any visas to enter Brunei Darussalam.

sources.title: Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Brunei Darussalam: Category D1
sources.said: Foreign nationals of countries under this category do not require any visas to enter Brunei Darussalam and are allowed to stay in the country for up to 90 days.

sources.title: Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Brunei Darussalam: Category D2
sources.said: Foreign nationals of countries under this category do not require any visas to enter Brunei Darussalam and are allowed to stay in the country for up to 30 days.

sources.title: Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Brunei Darussalam: Category D3
sources.said: Foreign nationals of countries under this category do not require any visas to enter Brunei Darussalam and are allowed to stay in the country for up to 14 days.

sources.title: Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Brunei Darussalam: Category C1 (Australia, Kuwait)
sources.said: Category C1 Visa on Arrival Holders of all types of passports under this category may apply visa (visa on arrival) upon entry into Brunei Darussalam. Type of Visa: Single or Multiple Entry Visa Visa duration: 30 days Fees: BND20.00 / BND30.00

sources.title: Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Brunei Darussalam: Category C2 (Saudi Arabia)
sources.said: Category C2 Visa on Arrival Holders of all types of passports under this category may apply visa (visa on arrival) upon entry into Brunei Darussalam. Type of Visa: Single Entry Visa Visa duration: 14 days Fees: BND20.00

sources.title: Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Brunei Darussalam: Category C3 (Qatar)
sources.said: Category C3 Visa on Arrival Holders of all types of passports under this category may apply visa (visa on arrival) upon entry into Brunei Darussalam. Type of Visa: Single or Multiple Entry Visa Visa duration: 14 days Fees: BND20.00

sources.title: Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Brunei Darussalam: Category C4 (Bahrain)
sources.said: Category C4 Visa on Arrival Holders of all types of passports under this category may apply visa (visa on arrival) upon entry into Brunei Darussalam. Type of Visa: Single or Multiple Entry Visa Visa duration: 14 days Fees: BND20.00 / BND30.00
